status: Local fixture infrastructure verified; installed updater outcomes belong to the separate device reports.

holdProtocol.setup: setNetworkFixture({config, platform, mode:'hold', path:new URL(selected.url).pathname}) returns holdId and statusPath; timeout-ms defaults to60000 and cannot exceed60000.
holdProtocol.acknowledgement: Read statusPath until its holdId matches and status is held. The server has received the exact immutable ZIP GET but has sent no response headers or body. Native disk-space preflight has completed before this request; device runners must independently establish the native target path before modifying it.
holdProtocol.release: setNetworkFixture({config, platform, mode:'release', 'hold-id':holdId}) releases only the matching gate. Per-platform control files isolate iOS and Android.
holdProtocol.termination: Deadline aborts the connection; normal/replaced/missing control cancels; client disconnect aborts; SIGTERM/SIGINT stops pending responses and server connections. The helper does not automatically send data when the deadline expires.
holdProtocol.guards: Exact selected-platform path and64hex.zip required, hold UUID and timeout validated, duplicate/consumed hold requests return409, control/status files cannot be fetched over HTTP. Server ignores caller-supplied statusPath and constructs its own local path.
holdProtocol.remaining: The25ms control-file poll detects an explicit release; it is not a sleep-based race with native path creation. Device code must finish preparation within the bounded request window or abort/retry safely. Extraction holds still require debugger coordination and are not implemented by this HTTP gate.

republishProtocol.behavior: Copies the existing valid archive without repackaging and signs a higher sequence while preserving bundle version, hash and URL. Appends brokenStartupRetry to the local checks report. Rejects invalid signature/hash/expiry/native bounds, remote or mismatched channels, non-increasing sequence and unsafe/duplicate destination names.
republishProtocol.concurrency: Create republications serially because the fixture checks report is shared; both round10 platform variants were created before device selection began.

assertions: All original signed fixture cases preserve source build and produce expected independent signature/hash/expiry/compatibility results.
Higher-sequence retry has exactly equal archive bytes, bundle version and hash; lower sequence, path traversal and corrupt source are rejected.
HTTPS interrupted transfer rejects, delayed transfer waits, normal transfer returns full bytes, manifests remain available and controls are hidden.
Held GET has no response headers; explicit matching release returns complete100000-byte fixture; duplicate GET returns409 and wrong release ID is rejected.
Wrong platform path and timeout above60000 are rejected;100ms test deadline aborts instead of delivering the ZIP.
Client disconnect, normal-mode cancellation and server shutdown settle the corresponding status and close pending requests.
verification.testScope: Temporary local fixtures and an ephemeral loopback HTTPS port only. Existing ignored QA signing/TLS material reused, no setup command or trust changes. Existing wrong-signature fixture generation uses a transient in-memory wrong signer. No test runner changes app/device files.
